sources.title: GitHub - EunB2/KL-RoBERTa
sources.snippet: KL-RoBERTa is a Korean legal language model designed for Korean legal natural language understanding tasks. The model aims to better capture legal terminology, long-form legal context, and domain-specific linguistic patterns in Korean legal texts. KL-RoBERTa is built on klue/roberta-base, an encoder-based Korean RoBERTa model, and retains the original architecture and tokenizer.
